name: rightsize
description: Automatically checks whether the current Claude model fits each substantial task and flags when a cheaper or stronger one would be better. Includes tiered subagents (Haiku / Sonnet / Opus) for delegating work at the right cost.

auto_precheck.title: Automatic pre-check
auto_precheck.description: Check whether the current model fits each substantial task before starting it. Turn off to use rightsize only when you ask.

refresh_every.title: Refresh the pre-check every N messages (default 15)
refresh_every.description: Re-adds the pre-check note every N messages so it doesn't fade in long sessions. Leave empty to use the default of 15. Set to 0 to refresh only at session start and after compaction.
